usageNotes: Converts an existing QEMU VM into a template, marking all its disks as base images so linked clones can be created from it. The VM must be stopped before calling this endpoint — converting a running VM is not allowed. Returns a task UPID; poll the task status to confirm completion before attempting to clone from the template.

examples.summary: Convert VM 200 to a full template on node pve1

tips: The VM must be powered off before conversion; the API will reject the request if it is running.
Once converted to a template, the VM can no longer be started directly — only cloned.
Omit the 'disk' body parameter to convert all disks to base images in one call; specify a single disk slot (e.g. 'scsi0') only when you need a partial conversion.
Linked clones (fast, thin-provisioned) require the source disk to be a base image, which this operation produces.
The operation is irreversible via the API — you cannot demote a template back to a regular VM without manual intervention in the Proxmox UI or config files.
